title: lease.kind@1
description: A resource kind the lease table grants (technical-design.md, Lease). The core declares its own; any plug-in declares more in its manifest, and a name belongs to the first that declares it.

name.description: The kind's name, such as port, cpu.slot or device.rig.

match.description: How two keys overlap, a closed list the kernel computes overlap from: exact keys when equal; globs when some path matches both; prefixes when one starts with the other; pool(n): at most n leases at once on a host.

cap.description: At most this many of the kind's leases held at once on a host; a run past it is BLOCKED.

cooldown.description: Milliseconds after a lease on a key ends before that key is leased again.

cost.description: The kind's cost per lease, in its own unit.
